prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a surreal, high-contrast black and white image featuring a young woman sitting curled up with her knees drawn to her chest, her arms wrapped around her legs. She is dressed in a full-body suit covered in a bold, black-and-white checkerboard pattern that seamlessly blends into the background and floor, creating a dizzying optical illusion. The background is a tunnel-like vortex of the same checkerboard pattern, drawing the viewer’s eye toward the center and enhancing the sense of depth and disorientation. The woman’s expression is introspective and somber, her head slightly bowed, with her dark hair tied up in a messy bun. The lighting is even and soft, eliminating harsh shadows and emphasizing the graphic quality of the scene. The overall style is hyperrealistic with a touch of surrealism, reminiscent of avant-garde fashion photography or conceptual art, with a strong focus on pattern, repetition, and visual tension. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, centering the subject and maximizing the immersive, hypnotic effect of the environment.
